definitions.explanation: The period of mourning observed after a death, during which one refrains from celebrations and social activities.

examples.japanese: {服喪|ふくもう}{中|ちゅう}は{外出|がいしゅつ}を{控|ひか}える。
examples.english: During mourning, one refrains from going out.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}が{亡|な}くなり、{家族|かぞく}で{服喪|ふくもう}の{期間|きかん}に{入|はい}った。
examples.english: After our grandmother passed away, the family entered a period of mourning.

examples.japanese: {服喪|ふくもう}{期間|きかん}が{明|あ}けるまで、{年賀状|ねんがじょう}の{送付|そうふ}は{控|ひか}えるのが{一般的|いっぱんてき}なマナーである。
examples.english: It is common etiquette to refrain from sending New Year's cards until the mourning period is over.

notes:
Refers to the formal period of mourning observed after the death of a family member or close relative. During {服喪|ふくもう}, people traditionally avoid celebrations, festive events, and sending seasonal greetings.

In Japan, the mourning period ({喪中|もちゅう}) typically lasts about one year for close relatives. During this time, families send {喪中|もちゅう}はがき (mourning postcards) before the New Year season to inform others that they will not be sending {年賀状|ねんがじょう} (New Year's cards).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {服喪|ふくもう}{中|ちゅう}: in mourning
- {服喪|ふくもう}{期間|きかん}: mourning period
- {服喪|ふくもう}が{明|あ}ける: the mourning period ends
- {服喪|ふくもう}に{入|はい}る: to enter mourning

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {喪中|もちゅう}: in mourning — the state of being in mourning, used more colloquially and on postcards
- {忌中|きちゅう}: a shorter, stricter mourning period (usually 49 days) immediately following a death
- {弔|とむら}い: mourning, condolence — focuses on the act of paying respects rather than the period
